core: Original core cardinalities retained verbatim in coverage.json.

resolved.budget_components: all seven named M1A components, never one scalar balance
resolved.budget_values: 0..12 plus explicit over-bound; positive money requests representable
resolved.faults: No-fault, one crash/restart, one partition with optional recovery, permanent nonresponse; fault dimensions may combine; receipts delayed/lost/duplicated independently.

slice.name: flow-control-construction-slice-v1
slice.distinction: Smaller subsystem exploration; cannot replace required core/cross-area profiles.
explicit_omissions: Remaining full M1B fields/lease/authentication/byte-cursor rules are outside the selected stream projection; opaque message arms are not capability successes.
Two total CREDIT source offers, complete-frame message tokens, one signaled SDK loss and bounded fragment counts restrict the environment; no parameterized cutoff claim.
Decoded event and wire-frame costs are abstract unit quanta; this slice does not certify actual UTF-8/JSON byte accounting.
Full five-stage per-queue/control-byte reserve profile is unimplemented; slice uses three logical data stages, two total in-flight messages and independent logical Stop.
No process launch, recipient execution, recovery, GoalSpec, shared-pool, effect-join or plugin implementation in this slice.
slice.design_revision: Before execution, lower per-stage slots to one while retaining two total in-flight messages, so a full downstream stage with waiting upstream work is reachable. The full profile still has two slots per stage and remains unimplemented.
slice.control_assumption: A dedicated logical Owner-control request and processing transition bypass all data stages. Physical admission/framing/scheduler/writer/view reserve survival is not established.
slice.loss_assumption: One SDK drop is accompanied atomically by a trustworthy loss signal. The interval before detecting a silent drop is not represented; unsupported detection is an explicit mapping assumption. A newly signaled loss supersedes ordinary flow recovery with RESET-only replay-gap state; this is checked separately.
slice.semantic_boundary: Preventive broker message-admission state, not the M1B posthoc wire-audit reducer. Rejected candidates do not advance admitted cursor; M1B retains rejected EVENT cursor/pending facts. Full wire-adapter mapping, including RESET after locally prevented exhaustion, is unimplemented.

construction_corrections.rule: One client and one stream per wire trace.
After replay gap, RESET is the only next same-stream message; any intervening message permanently refuses the trace. RESET clears credit and pending queue.
Owner Stop is outside the closed broker-message union and requires separately typed canonical control admission; physical route remains unselected.

limits: Finite domains are modeling limits, not runtime policy or a parameterized cutoff theorem.
Bad states and attempted over-bound actions must remain representable for mutant discrimination.
Domain proposal must be revised in both models if a required full-corpus trigger is unreachable.
Only the named small slice is implemented by this packet; full domain resolution does not imply full model coverage.
